''See also: [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sha Miara, also known as the [[Luminous Queen]], is a powerful figure and the [[Monarch]] of the [[Ninecloud Court]]. Though she publicly presents herself as an [[Underlady]] from a distant branch of her royal family, she is actually the true ruler. She assumed this position at age twelve after her mother, [[Luminous Queen Sha Leiala|Sha Leiala]], was forced to pass on her [[inheritance]] following a battle with plague-spirits that damaged her lifeline. To maintain the illusion that her mother is still reigning, Sha Miara uses a rainbow-colored [[madra]] disguise to [[The mask|mask]] her identity. This secret is known only to the [[Sha family]], their direct servants, and other [[Monarchs]]. Her power is characterized by [[royal madra]] that manifests as shimmering [[rainbow light]]. This energy is versatile enough to provide city-wide protection, create barriers, and even redirect the techniques of others. She possesses a deep connection to her lineage, often hearing the voices of her ancestors. Her [[Authority|authority]] can be delegated through a [[Divine Treasure]] called the [[Queen’s Gift]], which allows others to borrow her political and conceptual command. While she has been noted for her skill in archery and craftsmanship, her current power is restricted to the [[Underlord]] level, though she remains an exceptionally capable combatant and leader.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Luminous Queen]] is a girl of ten or eleven years old with fiery red hair adorned with glistening peacock feathers. She wears a shining [[The mask|mask]] and is often sheathed in rainbows.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sha Miara is an ally of [[Reigan Shen]], and the two are working together to protect [[Rosegold]]. She also followed [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] while sheathed in [[rainbow light]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Following the [[Path of Celestial Radiance]], she utilizes [[royal madra]] to perform various tasks. She can forge a [[sword]] made of blinding [[rainbow light]] and uses her power to provide [[rainbow light]] for protecting citizens or blocking bursts of energy.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ally of Reigan Shen}} ===

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“Miara. The Ghost is dragging the Phoenix and the Titan closer to Rosegold. Help me redirect them north.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I have relatives…” Sha Miara began, then straightened herself inside her rainbow disguise and spoke more confidently. “My family is still in Cradle, and I would like to know that they are safe.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31" />}}
